world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
world_org_meetings.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

world_org_meetings.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
world_org_meetings.description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

world_org_meetings.title: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

diplomatic_visits.title: EU leaders head into high-stakes budget battle as elections loom
diplomatic_visits.description: EU leaders on Thursday are holding talks seeking a deal on the bloc’s nearly €2 trillion budget for 2028-2034 by Christmas amid deep divisions over spending and fears that upcoming elections, particularly in France, could strengthen eurosceptic forces. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that EU leaders were still "very far apart" as he arrived at the summit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Kazakhstan seeks Antwerp-Bruges partnership to boost trade via Middle Corridor
diplomatic_visits.description: Kazakhstan is seeking closer cooperation with Belgium on the Middle Corridor, including a potential partnership between the Port of Antwerp-Bruges and the Caspian ports of Aktau and Kuryk, as King Philippe and Queen Mathilde make their first state visit to the country.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta crowds affirm Spanish identity during royal visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia received a rapturous welcome in Ceuta on Tuesday, 13 October, as they began their first visit to the Spanish North African territory since 2007.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta awaits King Felipe after summer migration crisis
diplomatic_visits.description: Ceuta braces for a symbolic royal visit by King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia after a mass migration crisis strained the enclave’s social cohesion.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta an 'inalienable' part of Spain, king says on key visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI on Tuesday said Ceuta and Melilla were "an inalienable part" of Spain as he made a landmark visit to the north African territories claimed by neighbouring Morocco. But the monarch, who rarely makes political interventions, emphasised Spain's need to "maintain good neighbourly relations" with Rabat after July's unprecedented migrant surge into Ceuta strained historically delicate ties. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, Spain.

elections.title: How high inflation is hurting Trump's Republicans in U.S. midterm campaign
elections.description: For nearly a year, U.S. President Donald Trump has been trying to persuade voters not to get riled up over rising prices, but polls suggest voters aren't buying his sales pitch, with respondents giving him low marks on the cost of living and disapproving of how he's handled inflation.

elections.title: EU leaders head for showdown over bloc long-term budget
elections.description: EU leaders on Thursday head for their biggest clash yet over the bloc's next long-term budget, as they race to lock in a deal before next year's French presidential election. The 27-nation European Union wants an agreement by Christmas, worried that any future dealmaking will be derailed by potential eurosceptic wins in polls taking place across the bloc -- most crucially in key power France. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels, Belgium.

elections.title: Africa records world's fastest gains in disaster resilience, new study shows
elections.description: The World Risk Poll, which surveyed 143,000 people across 140 countries, found North Africa up five points and Southern Africa up four, driven by expanding internet access and household preparedness. Yet 220 million people affected by disasters in the past five years received no warning.

elections.title: From Morocco to South Africa, Israel election watched closely across Africa
elections.description: October 27 vote could test whether Israel's ties with African countries withstand the fallout from the war on Gaza.

elections.title: Argentina’s Milei backs Trump for US midterms, calls vote crucial for West
elections.description: The US President's ally says conservatives “cannot give an inch” in Latin America as he accepts an award in Washington.
